source: convention: from a high plank with the hands wide, lower towards one hand (that elbow bends deep, the other arm straightens out to the side; mid), slide across low to the other hand, and back the same way up to the plank; hands and feet planted, the body turning slightly over them; the next rep starts towards the other hand; the way down and up is diagonal (to and from the first side) where the usual rep lowers and rises at the centre; tempo UNSOURCED; angles UNSOURCED
